questions.question: Two taps A and B can fill a tank in 10 hours and 12 hours respectively. If two taps are opened at 10 a.m., then at what time (in p.m.) should the tap A be closed to completely fill the tank at exactly 4 pm.
questions.solution:
Time for which B works = 6 hours

Work done by B = 6/12 = ½

Work done by A = 1 - ½ = ½

Time taken by A to do ½ of work = 10/2 = 5 hours

Time at which A should be closed = 10 + 5 = 15 hours i.e 3 p.m.

questions.question: Vijay and Sahil together can complete a work in 40 days. Sahil and Ranjit can complete the same work in 48 days and Vijay and Ranjit can complete the same work in 60 days. In how many days can all the three complete the same work while working together?
questions.solution:
Let the time taken to complete individually by Vijay, Sahil and Ranjit be a, b and c respectively

1/a + 1/b = 1/40

1/b + 1/c = 1/48

1/a + 1/c = 1/60

Time taken by all to complete the work = 1/(1/a + 1/b + 1/c)

(2/a + 2/b + 2/c) = 1/40 + 1/48 + 1/60

(1/a + 1/b + 1/c) = 1/32

Time taken by all to complete the work = 32 days

questions.question: The market price of an article is 50% more than its cost price. If 20% discount is given, then what will be the profit percent?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be x

Marked price = x + (50/100) × x = 3x/2

Discount = 20%

Selling price = 3x/2 - (20/100) × (3x/2) = 6x/5

Profit% = (6x/5 - x)/x × 100 = 20%

questions.question: After giving 40% discount on an article there is still a profit of 20%. What will be the profit percentage when no discount is given?
questions.solution:
Let the marked price be x

Selling price = x - (40/100) × x = 3x/5

Profit = 20%

Cost price = (3x/5) × (100/120) = x/2

Profit% when no discount is given = (x - x/2)/x/2 × 100 = 100%

questions.question: Profit obtained on selling an article for Rs. 310 is equal to the loss incurred on selling the article for Rs. 230. What will be the loss percentage when selling price is Rs. 180?

questions.question: P is 20% more than Q and 40% less than R. If value of Q is Rs. 150, then what is the value (in Rs.) of R?
questions.solution:
Value of P = 150 + (20/100) × 150 = 180

Let the value of R be x

Value of P = x - (40/100) × x = 60x/100

60x/100 = 180

x = Rs. 300

questions.question: The price of motor cycle depreciates every year by 8%. If the value of the motor cycle after 2 years will be Rs. 84640, then what is the present value (in Rs.) of the motor cycle?
questions.solution:
Let the present value of motorcycle be x

Value after 1 year = x × (92/100) = 92x/100

Value after 2 year = (92x/100) × (92/100) = (92/100)²x

(92/100)²x = 84640

x = Rs. 100000

questions.question: Diameter of the cycle wheel is 14 cm. A cyclist takes 30 minutes to reach a destination at a speed of 11 km/h. How many revolutions will the wheel make during the journey?
questions.solution:
Total distance covered in 1 revolution = 2πr = πd = (22/7) × 14 = 0.44 m

Total distance covered in journey = (Speed) × (Time) = 11 × (30/60) = 5.5 km = 5500 m

Total number of revolutions = 5500/0.44 = 12500

questions.question: A bus left 60 minutes later than the scheduled time but in order to reach the destination 48 km away in time, it had to increase its speed by 4 km/h from the usual speed. What is the usual speed (in km/hr) of the bus?
questions.solution:
Distance = (Speed) × (Time)

Let the actual speed be x

Let the time taken be y

Distance = xy

New speed = (x + 4) km/hr

Time taken = (y - 1) hr

Distance = (x + 4)(y - 1)

The total distance of the journey remains the same

(x + 4)(y - 1) = xy

xy + 4y - x - 4 = xy

(x + 4) = 4y

xy = 48 ⇒ y = 48/x

(x + 4) = 4 × 48/x

⇒ x = 12 km

questions.question: If x² + 1/x² = 7/4, then what is the value of x + 1/x?
questions.solution:
__**Concept**__:

a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab

__**Calculation**__:

Given: x2 + 1/x2 = 7/4

Here, we have to find the value of x + 1/x

As we know that, a2 + b2 = (a + b)2 - 2ab

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 7/4 + 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 15/4

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 15/4

Taking square root both sides (x + 1/x) = √15/2
